analysis:
Only docs/architecture/inference.md changed. The supplied units are base text at lines 6793-7655 (GLM pair admission, prefill bounds, still images, cluster stage KV precision, SSD prefix record encoding, Gemma/GPT-OSS lanes, manifest pins). The patch excerpt is truncated and shows only an added bullet describing `darkbloom cluster stop` / `stop` / `restart` ending cluster onboarding waits via a stopsAsked counter in the setup record. It is documentation only, so no executable code, key handling, wire protocol, authorization or attestation controls change in this PR.

The base text matters to the retained threat model. The cluster SSD prefix records section (7113-7278) describes an encrypted SSD tier, with a sealed header binding the encoding, a directory scope suffix, and fail-closed deletion of foreign-encoding records. This is consistent with T-041 (at-rest prefix cache, KEK/HMAC naming), and the docs don't claim any weakening. Manifest pin and repair text (7496-7535) is consistent with T-054-style identity pinning. It states repair never writes weight files and only replaces the manifest when the artifact identity matches.

The new stop-counter text describes a control protocol where the status reply carries stopsAsked (nil from older builds is ignored). I could not see the implementation or the transport authentication of ClusterControlReply, so whether a peer could spoof the count to end onboarding of the other Mac is an unverified contract. It is a minor availability question for integration, not a finding on this documentation-only change. No regressions or invalidated assumptions were identified in the supplied lines.
